latest.title: Como a AWS pode ajudar no início da sua carreira em tecnologia
latest.description:
Iniciar uma carreira em tecnologia pode ser desafiador, especialmente com a grande quantidade de ferramentas e conhecimentos necessários.

Nesse contexto, a AWS se destaca como uma plataforma que não apenas fornece serviços, mas também possibilita o desenvolvimento prático de habilidades valorizadas no mercado.

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 10: Putting It All Together
latest.description: In the final part we trace a single user request end-to-end through every layer of the platform — from the React frontend through FastAPI, the Orchestrator, Diagram Agent, Terraform Agent, and back. We also cover the Nova Act E2E test suite and what to build next

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 9: Deploying to AgentCore Runtime
latest.description: In Part 9 we deploy all three agents as AgentCore Runtime containers, the FastAPI backend on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront, and the React frontend to S3. You'll learn the Dockerfile pattern, Runtime YAML configs, CDK stacks, async job polling for long-running requests, and the four-layer security model

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 8: Observability with OpenTelemetry and X-Ray
latest.description: In Part 8 we instrument every agent operation with OpenTelemetry spans, record metrics to CloudWatch, emit structured failure logs, and wire the traceId into every API response. You'll see how to configure OTLP export to AWS X-Ray and correlate frontend errors with backend traces

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 7: Orchestrating Multiple Agents with LangGraph
latest.description: In Part 7 we build the Orchestrator Agent — a LangGraph-style state machine that classifies user requests, routes them to the Diagram and Terraform agents, runs both in parallel with asyncio.gather, validates cross-agent consistency, and handles iterative refinement with rollback

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 6: Policy as Code with Cedar
latest.description: In Part 6 we add Cedar-based fine-grained access control to every agent tool call. You'll learn how to write Cedar policies, build a Python policy engine, enforce deny-overrides-permit evaluation, and implement hot-reload so policy changes take effect in under 10 seconds without restarting agents.

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 5: Memory — Short-Term and Long-Term Context
latest.description: In Part 5 we integrate AgentCore Memory to give agents persistent context. You'll learn how to store session-scoped memory, retrieve long-term facts across sessions, use semantic search over past interactions, and implement artifact versioning with rollback support.

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 4: MCP Tool Integration via AgentCore Gateway
latest.description: In Part 4 we register AWS Pricing API, the Well-Architected Tool, and a diagram-rendering Lambda as MCP tools via AgentCore Gateway. You'll learn how to define tools, authenticate agent requests with short-lived credentials, handle retries, and invoke Gateway targets with SigV4 signing

latest.title: Building a Multi-Agent AWS Platform with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Part 3: Tool Integration — Code Interpreter and Browser Tool
latest.description: In Part 3 we give our agents real tools: the AgentCore Code Interpreter for sandboxed diagram rendering and Terraform validation, and the AgentCore Browser Tool for navigating live AWS documentation. We also build the self-correction retry loop that makes agents resilient to transient failures.

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
